title: Revised nomenclature, definitions, and correlations for the Cretaceous formations in USGS-Clubhouse Crossroads #1, Dorchester County, South Carolina
citation: Gohn, G.S., 1992, Revised nomenclature, definitions, and correlations for the Cretaceous formations in USGS-Clubhouse Crossroads #1, Dorchester County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 1518 [39 p.], map scale 1:300,284.
notes:
Packet 1 (pages 1-31) of Gohn 1992 PP 1518. Plate 1 (page 1) is OCR of a log cross section; only formation names legible, not recorded. Pamphlet text is two-column; quotes chosen from single-column segments. Bladen Formation description continues in packet 2. Reference list is in packet 2.
Packet 2 (pages 32-45). Bladen Formation continues from packet 1. References limited to South Carolina and Carolinas Coastal Plain items; general paleontology and non-SC references skipped; citations recorded by first line only. Ages restated in the biostratigraphy review (pp. 36-42) recorded once per unit.
